The designer should either widen the tolerances to accommodate the coating or add a note specifying that dimensions apply after plating.","recommended_correction":"Add plating-thickness allowance to the ±0.1 mm toleranced sizes, or add a note stating that the given dimensions apply after surface treatment."}]}
